G57's reading 13, stated after reading the quotes of P19's absent candidates (d3_absent_cites_P19_1 to _8) and before the absent rows are written; not an amendment. (1) Inside, on or over: a line fails its claim of absence where its concepts place a work on, in, over, under or behind another room's mark (its flag, logo, road, badge, art or taskbar) or in ground the speaker names as that room's (its territory, area or section, or a spot it gives), with that room asked or ruling; and where a room is asked for, or gives, leave to build and no place beside its work is named, since the room asked is then the one that may allow it (globaloffensive c0908, denverbroncos c0036, tf2 c0236). (2) Beside: a request or leave to build beside, above, below, next to or between another room's works, an offer of the space below, and pixels ceded at a border are P08, as reading 10 held for lakers-032 (necrodancer c0092, neu c0026, ucf c0089, xenoblade_chronicles c0051, bardmains c0057, uiowa c0024, hentai c0083); PR keeps G57's 'inside or beside' (KState c0035, uruguay c0008). (3) A guest that fits its work to a colour host's rule so that the host admits or ignores it is RU, and the host CO (TeamDignitas c0025, anime_irl c0014, hsv c0045, southpark c0003). CO marks a colour faction (GreenLattice, the Blue Corner, a purple or red faction, PurplePixels, the Void, SquareSpiral) or a host whose colour or pattern decides in the quote (the rainbow kept whole: rit c0069, smite c0236, strangerthings c0034); a request to the road's room alone is not CO. (4) A concept label of the line's own that names a request to a named host, or a host's refusal, is the line's evidence where the members' words cannot be quoted under the quote rules (greenbaypackers c0172, HomestarRunner c0099, satania c0082). (5) A member's own hope for a flag inside the room's flag is P02 (placecanada c0186), as reading 2 held. (6) The NONPORTABLE lines are particulars under G6; PO marks those whose concepts show P19 (belgium-020, dota2-040, ethereum-021, mariokart-031, ravens-032). Quoted lines that show only borders, alliances, pleas, help or a member's own idea, and the lines not quoted, stay evidence limits. Next: P19-absent-spec parts 1 to 6

Seven unquoted lines were quoted into d3_absent_cites_P19_9.txt. Under reading 13(3) and G57's PR and DI, four fail their claim of absence: blackmirror-032 (logos coloured to the rainbow so as not to cut the road), lofihiphop-026 (only the black filled so the road does not destroy the work), puzzleanddragons-041 (a work completed in the path of blue or rainbow so that they grant protection status, the work before the host, F-012's order) and detroitredwings-065 (a room holding a guest to the leave it did not ask beforehand, DI). davidbowie-027 (a rainbow pushing back) and aromantic-025 (a guest stopping on a flag, the ruling not quoted) stay limits. P19's census rules, logged before d3_p19_census.py runs (G57's census paragraph). (1) A line shows P19 when its tag row holds a form (AS, PR, RU or DI): the instantiate SHOW lines, the restrict, add-condition and add-step S-SHOW lines, the link S-SHOW, S-OTHER, E-PAIR and PART lines, the rejected absent lines, and the particulars marked PO; evidence limits, NOT and EL-NOT lines and particulars without PO do not. A room shows P19 when one of its lines does. (2) Counted: lines by op and class; rooms by form and mark; rooms whose only form is AS (a request with no ruling, protection or dispute shown) beside rooms with RU; rooms with HO, with GU, and with both; rooms with OE, and with VE only; rooms with CO, and the share of RU rooms that are CO; AC-only and PO-only rooms. (3) Overlaps, by room: rooms showing P19 that K04's tag files mark CO; and rooms that P08, P16, P17 and P21 show, where a room is shown by an element when one of the element's lines (its ids read from its ruling files) has, as its latest line in adjudications.jsonl, an accept with a kind other than none, or a reject on an absent line. (4) F-012's order is not counted, since no tag marks it; the lines that show it are named (gamindustri-017, puzzleanddragons-041). (5) The count does not decide the status ruling; the reasons do (QD3-002)
